use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Globalization.CultureInfo

show(expression: string, value: double) =>
    write_line(
        "{expression,-28} {value.to_string(CultureInfo.invariant_culture)}")

show(expression: string, value: bool) =>
    write_line("{expression,-28} {value}")

let zero = 0.0
let one = 1.0

let minus_zero = -zero
let positive_infinity = one / zero
let negative_infinity = -one / zero
let not_a_number = zero / zero

show("-0.0", minus_zero)
show("1.0 / 0.0", positive_infinity)
show("-1.0 / 0.0", negative_infinity)
show("0.0 / 0.0", not_a_number)

write_line("")
show("double.negative_infinity", double.negative_infinity)
show("double.positive_infinity", double.positive_infinity)
show("double.na_n", double.na_n)

write_line("")
show("-0.0 == 0.0", minus_zero == zero)
show("1.0 / -0.0", one / minus_zero)
show("nan == nan", not_a_number == not_a_number)
show("double.is_na_n(nan)", double.is_na_n(not_a_number))

write_line("")
show("infinity + 1.0", positive_infinity + one)
show("infinity - infinity", positive_infinity + negative_infinity)
show("infinity * 0.0", positive_infinity * zero)
show("1.0 / infinity", one / positive_infinity)
